Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects

Class ResultObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.objects.ResultObject
public final class ResultObject extends SceneObject
Semantic answer card with centered text, inherited opacity and animatable glow/scale.

Chooses accent colours from SUCCESS, ANSWER, WARNING or INFO semantics and centers the answer within a rounded card. Normal opacity, scale and glow properties can emphasize the result.
